name: Webflow
whatYouLose: A professional-grade visual CSS and layout engine
Managed CMS, hosting, localization and client workflows
Years of browser compatibility and publishing edge cases
prompt: Build an opinionated marketing-site studio rather than a Webflow clone. Users choose structured sections, edit content and design tokens, bind collection data, preview responsive breakpoints, publish Astro pages, manage SEO and forms, and export the generated project. Use Astro SSR, vanilla JavaScript and SQLite. Do not implement arbitrary CSS positioning; constrain the system so every generated site remains accessible and responsive.
notes: You can generate excellent sites with constraints. Recreating a general visual web-development environment in one prompt is fantasy.
